messages:
maria_r: Quick sync on admission-shim rollout. I sketched a smaller-surface v1 after yesterday's RFC follow-up. want to confirm ops/telemetry requirements before I ship the prototype.
akash_k: cool. what's the v1 smaller surface?
maria_r: admit-only shim that: classifies requests into queue_tags, emits expected_wait_ms, and returns an opaque slot_token for potential warmups. NO hard routing changes in v1 — only telemetry and a probabilistic canary routing flag.
linh_t: so workers ignore slot_token by default until we flip canaries?
maria_r: yes. workers will treat slot_token as optional. when enabled for canary tenants, workers will call KV.Pin(slot_token) if present. if pin fails or token missing we log a cold-exec.
sam_sre: must have clear metrics for cold vs warm executions. propose: metric labels: model, queue_tag, tenant, exec_cold:boolean. also add fastpath_cost_usd gauge.
devops_j: ops asks for per-region ff toggles and a global kill-switch that maps to legacy routing. Also need dashboard with synthetic tests that exercise tiny-reqs vs stream-reqs.
akash_k: on probabilistic routing: we should implement two knobs: base_prob (global) and surge_prob (triggered when queue growth rate > X). avoids sudden mass fastpathing.
linh_t: agree. also add rate-limited warmup dedupe: a short-lived cache keyed by (model, queue_tag, slot_prefix) that drops duplicate warmup work for ~200ms.
maria_r: good note. avoidance of warmup stampedes is critical. implementation idea: warmup requests go to a local in-memory dedupe table; if already warming, bump a counter and ignore. only expose 'warmup_attempts' and 'warmup_dropped' metrics.
sam_sre: add alerting: if warmup_dropped > warmup_attempts * 0.9 over 5m, fire P1 for misconfigured dedupe.
akash_k: what's the slot_token structure? keep opaque but version it. propose base64(v1|tenant|rand). workers treat prefix to pick decoder.
linh_t: keep it opaque in API docs; internal can be structured. public clients must not parse.
maria_r: API sketch (HTTP/grpc):
POST /v1/admit
body: { model: string, tokens: int, urgency?: "low"|"normal"|"interactive", cache_hint?: "warm"|"none", tenant_id?: string, policy_id?: string }
resp: { enqueued: true|false, slot_token?: string, queue_tag: string, expected_wait_ms: int }

akash_k: small rename request: `tokens` -> `token_count` and `expected_wait_ms` -> `expected_wait_ms_est`. makes it clear it's an estimate.
maria_r: done.
sam_sre: need an explicit schema for the metrics exposition: prometheus names and labels. list to include: admission_enqueues_total{queue_tag,model,tenant}, admission_rejects_total{reason}, admission_expected_wait_seconds_bucket{le,queue_tag}, worker_execs_total{model,queue_tag,tenant,exec_cold}, warmup_attempts_total, warmup_dropped_total, queue_circuit_tripped_total.
devops_j: also add a tracing span name "admission.enqueue" and carry traceparent through slot_token to correlate.
linh_t: about preemption: v1 won't add preempt APIs. let's rely on DrainHint as discussed earlier and instrument drain_hints_emitted_total. we can revisit preemptishes later.
maria_r: rollout plan: (A) feature flag deploy + telemetry-only mode for 72h, (B) enable tagging for 1% traffic in staging, run simulator, (C) enable slot_token warmups for canary tenants (Dedicated partners), (D) enable circuit-breaker and fastpath with surge_prob, starting at 0.5% and ramp. each step needs canary dashboards and rollback playbook.
sam_sre: rollback playbook: flip ff/queue-ecosystem-v1 off per-region -> all enqueues land on legacy shaper; verify redispatch queues drain <5m; if not, kill new worker processes. add runbook entry.
akash_k: prototype notes: implement admission shim in Rust and expose a shared-memory segment for per-worker clients to read queue_tag/state. cheap path <500ns if resident. we'll benchmark.
devops_j: make sure the shim respects container restarts: shared-memory clearing, and fallback to rpc if shm missing.
maria_r: one more operational failure-mode: lost slot_token mid-flight. decision: worker treats as cold-exec and tags metric exec_cold=true. track a SLA for slot-token loss rate <0.1%.
linh_t: simulation harness is required: generator with mixture of small (1-6 tokens), medium (7-64), streaming sessions. measure p50/p95/p99 latency and cost-per-1M tokens. please add a knob to vary inter-arrival burstiness.
maria_r: i'll add harness to my PR. akash will prototype shim and warmup dedupe. sam will author dashboards/alerts. devops_j will wire feature flags. i'll draft the RFC follow-up doc with this plan and a short appendix enumerating metrics + rollback steps. comments welcome.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag ff/queue-ecosystem-v1 created in staging.
akash_k: I'll attach initial benchmark numbers to the draft by EOD tomorrow.
maria_r: thanks all, ping me for reviews. :thumbsup:
